Overview

Atlanta is a city in GA with a population of 510,823. The South’s economic capital with affordable living, film production, and Southern hospitality. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 8a growing zone supports Warm — citrus, avocados, tomatoes, peppers. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. The population skews young, with a median age of 34.0.
